messages:
jesse: Heads-up: enabling our SDK's "buffer-for-retry" option caused an OOM on an Android 8 device during large file uploads in the sample app. Repro easy with 50MB file.

rina: ouch. do you have heap / oom trace? which buffer strategy are we using (in-memory vs temp file)?

jesse: stack trace points to okhttp3.internal.http2.Http2Stream$FramedDataSource.read and then a big byte[] in our buffering util. Heap shot up to ~200MB then crash. trace: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Failed to allocate a 52428812 byte allocation`

theo: if buffer-for-retry keeps whole request body in memory that's expected. For large payloads we should fallback to streaming-to-disk + replayable FileRequestBody. In general: small payloads can use ByteArray cache, otherwise spill-to-disk.

miguel: agree. also note: Retrofit's converters sometimes hold references to InputStreams if we wrap them incorrectly. Make sure writeTo() reads from file/stream then closes.

jesse: here's current naive helper in sample: 
```kotlin
fun bufferForRetry(body: RequestBody): RequestBody {
  val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream()
  val sink = bytes.sink().buffer()
  body.writeTo(sink)
  sink.close()
  return RequestBody.create(body.contentType(), bytes.toByteArray())
}
```

rina: yeah that's the culprit. that creates a huge byte[] for every buffered request. change to thresholded spill: write to temp file if size > 1MB.

theo: example ReplayableRequestBody for file fallback: 
```kotlin
class ReplayableRequestBody(private val file: File?, private val data: ByteArray?, private val mediaType: MediaType?) : RequestBody() {
  override fun contentType() = mediaType
  override fun contentLength() = file?.length() ?: data?.size?.toLong() ?: 0L
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) {
    file?.source()?.use { it.readAll(sink) } ?: data?.let { sink.write(it) }
  }
}
```

miguel: plus we need to ensure temp files are created on app cache dir and cleaned up on success/failure. Add security check for external storage.

jesse: will implement. another weird bit: on some older devices we started seeing TLS handshake errors after switching okhttp to ConnectionSpec.MODERN_TLS to match server preferences. Android 7 devices failing on ECDHE_AES_128_GCM_SHA256.

rina: that's probably session resumption and cipher mismatch. Android platform TLS stack differs across APIs. For compatibility we often add a fallback ConnectionSpec including TLS 1.2 + recommended ciphers, e.g. custom ConnectionSpec with TLS versions [TLS_1_2] and cipher suites that are widely supported. Also check enableTls12OnPreLollipop if needed.

theo: snippet: 
```kotlin
val compat = ConnectionSpec.Builder(ConnectionSpec.MODERN_TLS)
  .tlsVersions(TlsVersion.TLS_1_2)
  .cipherSuites(
    CipherSuite.TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,
    CipherSuite.TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,
    CipherSuite.TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
  ).build()
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder().connectionSpecs(listOf(compat, ConnectionSpec.CLEARTEXT)).build()
```

miguel: good. also enable explicit OkHttp logging only in dev; our logging interceptor holds body in memory for introspection which can again blow up if left on in prod samples. Add a debug-only flag.

jesse: good call. one more Android-specific: cancelling uploads from UI sometimes leaked cursor/file descriptor on older APIs unless we call sink.close() from the cancel path. We should add cooperative cancellation: wrap stream in ForwardingSink that checks a volatile cancelled flag and throws IOException to stop writeTo.

rina: can we add a small utility in SDK: `ReplayableBodyFactory.create(requestBody, thresholdBytes = 1_048_576)` plus `RequestUtils.wrapCancellable(body)` ? then sample can show progress + cancel.

theo: add tests: MockWebServer that pauses reading mid-upload to simulate slow network and assert temp file created, cleaned, and no OOM. Also run on API 23/26/28/31 matrix in CI.

eng-ci-bot: regression detected: sample-app-large-upload (android-8-emulator) failed 2/5 runs due to OOM. See job 1229.

jesse: I'm splitting this into two PRs: (1) sample app change for buffer->threshold+file fallback + cancelable wrapper + docs, (2) SDK utility + unit tests + integration tests.

miguel: tiny UX note: document that automatic buffering for retry is opt-in and disabled by default. add telemetry event `retry_buffering_used` with size and fallback type (memory|file). helps ops.

jesse: will do. thanks all. I'll ping when PRs up for CI matrix run.

devex-bot: reminder: link the PR to issue #4823 and include `breaking-change: false` label for sample API.
